requirement: site.rebuild on an EmDash site wearing a design-system slot names every class written since the last build that pins a value the slot owns, with its place and the slot-relative class to write, builds anyway and puts the fix before the reply; page.look names a literal winning over one of the slot's variables as a pin

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: Stand from #1100 @ 8323b61f7 (10/10/2026), dskeepem wearing Moxie, 'Cho nút chính ở đầu trang chủ nhỏ lại một chút': the context held the round-2 Design system line word for word, yet the agent changed only the padding offsets and the size with one string replace, kept '!rounded-full', wrote '!text-[16px]', and site.rebuild answered only 'Tell the customer in one line what changed and where to look.'; under MotherDuck (2px) the hero stayed a pill. The dist assumption measured on the stand: the hero's current class string is in /app/dist (626 files, 35 MB, 0.9 s), the one an earlier turn replaced is not.
oracle.invariant: The container read (the same script the site's container runs, run by node on a fixture /app): on a site wearing the slot it returns only the class strings of source files saved after the last build that the last build's /app/dist does not contain — the hero line Home.astro:85 as the agent rewrote it, not the unchanged band button at :185, not an unused component older than the build and absent from dist; nothing saved since the build, nothing judged; with no slot it reads nothing else; with no dist it judges nothing. The measured turn (class 'btn-primary !rounded-full !px-[calc(var(--ds-btn-pad-x,30px)+8px)] !py-[calc(var(--ds-btn-pad-y,15px)+6px)] !text-[16px]'): two findings at src/views/Home.astro:85 — '!rounded-full' → '!rounded-[var(--ds-btn-radius,9999px)]' (a literal radius over --ds-btn-radius) and '!text-[16px]' → 'text-[16px]' (`!` before a literal); the next starts 'Built, but 2 classes written since the last build pin a value the design-system slot owns' and says 'Before you tell the customer anything, in this same turn: make each replacement … then ONE site.rebuild again.' The classifier: button padding, radius, colours (nearest --ds-c-*) and heading sizes become slot-relative with the literal as fallback; relative classes, non-button padding and plain literal sizes pass; a `!` before a literal is named anywhere. rebuildSite reads the pins before `astro build`, builds anyway, and answers findings + next + a detail naming them; with no slot or no answer from the read it answers as before (no findings, default next). The build host hands an operation's findings and its own next to the agent, and keeps the default next when the operation gives none. page.look on the slot site: the hero's 'border-radius: 2147483647px !important' row gets pin "a literal over the slot's --ds-btn-radius: the next system will not reach it — write var(--ds-btn-radius, 2147483647px)"; rows set through the slot's variables get none; a literal colour names the nearest --ds-c-*; Joomla corners name --radius-pill; a slot with no such variable says nothing. Exit 0, '# fail 0'.
